metadata.description: 0 to 1 Labs Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: codex-pr-review
plugins.description: Review a pull request using a dual-family pipeline (OpenAI Codex + Claude) with a cross-family grounded verifier and a deterministic lint/typecheck/test floor.

plugins.name: claude-code-prompt-optimizer
plugins.description: Wrap a prompt in <optimize>...</optimize> and it is rewritten into a sharper prompt by the same model your session is running. Hook-based (UserPromptSubmit).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Drop-in replacement for Anthropic's frontend-design skill, built on the September 2026 upstream, plus a design-direction statement, font-loading mechanics, and a concrete accessibility and responsive quality floor.

plugins.name: gemini
plugins.description: Google Gemini media skills for Claude Code: image generation and editing (Nano Banana Pro), video (Omni, Veo), music (Lyria), text-to-speech, and video/audio/PDF/YouTube understanding. One GEMINI_API_KEY, one skill per service.

plugins.name: iac-diagram-generator
plugins.description: Analyzes Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Docker Compose) and generates professional cloud architecture diagrams with Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image).

plugins.name: iac-security-scan
plugins.description: Scans Terraform and CloudFormation for security misconfigurations (Kubernetes and Compose: findings only), maps findings to NIST 800-53 / FedRAMP controls, and generates validated remediation IaC.

plugins.name: codex-dispatch
plugins.description: Route a prompt to OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 sol/astra/luna) via /codex and get a synthesized answer back — like delegating to a subagent. Read-only by default; write mode only on request.

plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Context-aware documentation for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that lexically retrieves and injects the most relevant doc sections (docs/ plus root *.md by default) under a token budget. Optional glossary pins; no keyword map required.

plugins.name: elevenlabs
plugins.description: Text-to-speech, speech-to-text (Scribe v2), and sound effects with the ElevenLabs API. Zero-dependency Python script, key from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, audio saved to disk. Adds a /say command and an auto-triggering skill.

plugins.name: xcode-development
plugins.description: Factory for personal and family iPhone/iPad apps and games with Xcode 27: /xcode-development:init scaffolds a workspace, new-app creates an XcodeGen app or SpriteKit game with tests, lint, hooks, and CI, plus skills for build, simulator, device install, TDD loop, review, and remote Macs. Privacy-first, free Personal Team signing, Xcode 27 MCP tools.
